subject: Analog Electronics
questionText:
Consider a basic amplifier circuit having input
resistance, Ri = 10 k and output resistance, Ro = 1 k
and loop gain is T = 104. What are the maximum
possible output resistance and minimum possible
input resistance respectively.
(a)
1 , 104 k
(b)
 , 0 
(c)
10–1 , 10 M
(d)
104k, 1 
explanation: Practice Question from Analog Electronics DPP-06 (EC/EE/IN).
